composition_variation: Create an elegant anime illustration of adult Hinata Hyuga taking a calm evening walk in light snowfall. Preserve her deep indigo hair, straight bangs, pale lavender eyes, and gentle confident expression. Dress her in a long lavender winter coat, cream scarf, opaque trousers, and boots. Show a modest three-quarter turn as she looks toward a warm paper lantern beside a shop entrance. Use powder blue snow, plum shadows, gold lamplight, and a soft mostly empty upper evening sky. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
